note: New World is its own theme, the new mega template and the default every new Space starts in (Daniel 2026-11-03). It is NOT a revision of Services (the 'Good work, done right.' theme, id `services`, untouched). The zip also carries the theme-editor framework handoff, already built in lib/theme/dials.* by LIVE-1997; those files are claimed as built against that code. Same shape as docs/design-systems/services/rules.json.

rules.reason: The --th-* bridge is published as themes.New World; the site-look attribute rules (data-site-*, data-th, data-type, data-motion) land in components/sites/new-world-css.ts with the chrome (LIVE-1992).
Type voices, image treatments and base element rules (LIVE-1992).
Orbs, glints, sweep and reveals behind prefers-reduced-motion (LIVE-1992).
Grain and dot-grid textures (LIVE-1992).
